identity.captured_title: You are the Deep Research source-base reviewer for NebulaMind's galaxy-evolution wiki rebuild. Queue item 07 of 20 Core review: Péroux, Céline & Howk, J. Christopher (2020), Annual Review of Astronomy and Astrophysics, volume 58, pages 363-406, "The Cosmic Baryon and Metal Cycles." Verified review identity to confirm: DOI 10.1146/annurev-astro-021820-120014; arXiv 2011.01935; ADS bibcode 2020ARA&A..58..363P. Mission purpose Build a large, authoritative, advisory source base from this review so three independent methods can later build galaxy-evolution wiki pages from zero. Extract its bounded synthesis and harvest important primary papers it actually cites. This is not live-wiki prose and authorizes no database, trust, claim, evidence, deployment, publication, git, account-setting, or conversation-deletion action beyond this one Deep Research run. Temporal and topical boundary - Use the 2020 review and primary literature it actually cites. - Do not promote post-2020 papers as if the review cited them. - Maintain the queue's non-AGN focus. Exclude AGN fueling, accretion physics, AGN demographics, and AGN-only feedback papers from the core harvest. - Later sources and AGN-centered sources may appear only in DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED. Scientific scope 1. Cosmic inventories of baryons in stars, atomic gas, molecular gas, ionized gas, circumgalactic gas, intracluster gas, and the intergalactic medium. 2. Cosmic neutral-hydrogen and molecular-hydrogen mass densities and their redshift evolution. 3. Quasar absorption-line tracers: DLAs, sub-DLAs, Lyman-limit systems, metal ions, ionization corrections, dust obscuration, and selection effects. 4. Metal production, yields, metal mass density, phase partition, stellar and gas reservoirs, circumgalactic/IGM metals, and the modern missing-metals question. 5. Dust-to-gas and dust-to-metals ratios, depletion, extinction/reddening, neutral-gas dust density, and metallicity dependence. 6. Cosmic star-formation history, molecular depletion time, halo growth, net accretion, outflow, recycling, and baryon-cycle closure. 7. Observational versus simulation censuses, tracer incompleteness, ionization/temperature corrections, phase boundaries, and cosmological parameter dependence. 8. Preserve comoving density, density parameter, mass fraction, metallicity, and metal mass density as distinct quantities. Required output 1. Review identity and scope map - Confirm exact title, authors, year, journal, DOI, arXiv, and ADS bibcode. - Map authorized scientific territory and explicit exclusions. - Preserve phase, tracer, ionization, temperature, sample, redshift, abundance-scale, IMF/yield, and cosmological boundaries. 2. Established findings - At least 12 atomic entries [REV07-E01], ... - Include role, epistemic_type, one bounded finding, physical/sample/tracer boundary, review topic basis, confidence note, and source keys. - Allowed epistemic types: observation | analytic_theory | hydrodynamic_simulation | semi_analytic_model | calibration | review_synthesis. - Never collapse stars, neutral gas, molecular gas, CGM, IGM, intracluster gas, dust, total baryons, metals, and metallicity into interchangeable quantities. 3. Open debates and tensions - At least 8 entries [REV07-D01], ... - Include competing positions, why unresolved in 2020, boundaries, and source keys. - Include: HI evolution and absorber selection; molecular-gas census and conversion factors; ionized/CGM baryon corrections; metal-yield/IMF systematics; missing metals versus census closure; dust obscuration bias; dust-to-metals evolution; and observations versus simulation phase partition. 4. Key measurements, model benchmarks, and calibrations - At least 8 entries [REV07-N01], ... - Include exact value/equation when the review supplies it; units; phase/tracer/sample/redshift/cosmology/IMF; whether observed, assumed, calibrated, or predicted; caveat; and source keys. - Useful targets: Omega_HI behavior to z~5; cosmic H2 density evolution; molecular depletion time; stellar mass density; cold-gas metal density at z>2.5; z<1 stellar metal dominance; baryon fractions in collapsed structures; dust-to-gas or dust-to-metals behavior; and cosmic dust density. Include only values bound to cited sources and review context. 5. What remained unknown in 2020 - At least 6 entries [REV07-U01], ... with the gap, why it matters, needed observation/model test, and source keys. 6. Primary-citation harvest - Harvest 40-80 important PRIMARY papers actually cited by Péroux & Howk 2020. - Balance across HI/DLA surveys, molecular-gas surveys, stellar-mass inventories, CGM/IGM baryons, metal censuses, abundance/yield work, dust/depletion measurements, baryon-cycle observations, and simulations. - Supporting reviews/books may be listed separately but must not count toward the primary total. - Exclude post-2020, uncited search results, aggregators, and AGN-only papers. - One physical paper per source key; no duplicates. - IDs [REV07-P001], [REV07-P002], ... - Each row: [REV07-PNNN] Authors (year, journal) | title=exact title | DOI:value-or-none; arXiv:value-or-none; ADS:value | role=measurement|analytic_theory|hydrodynamic_simulation|semi_analytic_model|calibration | review_locator=section/topic | one-line boundary - If an identifier or review membership is uncertain, quarantine the row rather than making it usable. Composite identifier discipline - First author/year/title/DOI/arXiv/ADS must identify the same physical paper. - The paper must actually appear in the review bibliography. - Never splice neighboring reference identifiers. - Use none when an identifier genuinely does not exist. - Measurement rows must name the phase, tracer, ionization/depletion correction, and cosmological normalization they depend on. 7. DO_NOT_USE_UNVERIFIED - Quarantine uncertain, cross-wired, uncited, post-2020, AGN-centered, phase-collapsing, or overbroad items. - Format: UNCITED_NOT_USABLE | candidate or claim | supplied identifier/context | exclusion reason - Explicitly quarantine claims that all baryons are detected, one absorber class measures all gas, all metals occupy one phase, no missing-metals problem means every reservoir is known, or matching one global density validates one unique baryon-cycle model. - Quarantine post-2020/JWST/ML browsing results. 8. Review and source identity ledger - Repeat review as [REV07-R00] with DOI/arXiv/ADS. - Repeat every usable primary and supporting row with author/year/journal, DOI, arXiv, ADS, role, and boundary. - No load-bearing source may be absent from this ledger. Quality bar - Advisory source base, not polished wiki prose. - Prefer explicit phase/tracer/census boundaries over broad claims. - Preserve observed versus inferred, calibrated versus predicted, and density versus fraction versus metallicity. - Every source key in findings/debates/measurements/unknowns must resolve in the usable ledger. - End exactly: REVIEW_BASE_07_DR_COMPLETE_REFERENCE_ONLY
